reading.body:
Microsoft does not publish the power capacity, square footage, or detailed specifications of the CYS41 campus or its parent Cheyenne data center campus. The operator discloses only worldwide aggregate statistics: 80+ Azure regions, 500+ datacenters globally, and 40+ gigawatts of renewable energy contracted across all operations. Whether this Wyoming facility is a hyperscale training hub, inference cluster, or development site cannot be determined from published sources.

Wyoming has four mapped data center facilities on record, none with published power capacity. CYS41 is owned and operated by Microsoft, one of three major cloud operators with substantial infrastructure presence in the state. Local reporting indicates Microsoft has announced expansion plans and intended acquisition of 3,200 acres in the Cheyenne area, but the timeline, scale, and completion status of that expansion are not published by the operator.

Without disclosed megawatt capacity or technical specifications, this campus cannot be ranked against other AI infrastructure sites or assessed for its relevance to AI scaling constraints. A reader tracking the grid as the binding constraint on AI compute must treat Microsoft's Wyoming operations as a known but unquantified allocation of resources, and monitor public announcements for any future disclosure of deployment size or power draw.
